question: When x is subtracted from each of 21, 22, 60 and 64, the numbers so obtained in this order, are in proportion, what is the mean proportional between (x - 2) and (2x + 8)?
solution:
**Given:**

The numbers = 21, 22, 60, and 64

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ {21 - xover 22 - x} = {60 - xover 64 - x}

By dividendo and componendo

⇒ 1344 - 64x - 21x + x² = 1320 - 22x - 60x + x²

⇒ 3x = 24

⇒ x = 8

The mean proportion = √{(x - 2) × (2x + 8)} = √{(8 - 2) × (2 × 8 + 8)} = √(6 × 24) = √144 = 12

**∴ The required result will be 12.**
